CREATE TABLE "public"."authSession" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "revokedAt" timestamptz(3),
  "sessionTokenHash" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."bill" (
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "issuedAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "orderId" text NOT NULL,
  "paidAt" timestamptz(3),
  "status" text DEFAULT 'UNPAID' NOT NULL,
  "subtotal" numeric NOT NULL,
  "taxAmount" numeric NOT NULL,
  "taxRate" numeric NOT NULL,
  "total" numeric NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "bill_status_check_14bc68ed" CHECK ("status" IN ('UNPAID', 'PARTIALLY_PAID', 'PAID', 'VOID'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."category" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "displayOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."conversation" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "customerId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'OPEN' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "conversation_status_check_32214e16" CHECK ("status" IN ('OPEN', 'CLOSED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."conversationParticipant" (
  "conversationId" text NOT NULL,
  "joinedAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("conversationId", "userId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."customizationGroup" (
  "displayOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."customizationOption" (
  "displayOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "groupId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isAvailable" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "priceDelta" numeric DEFAULT '0'::numeric NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ingredient" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."menuItem" (
  "categoryId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "imageUrl" text NOT NULL,
  "isAvailable" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "isBuildable" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "preparationTimeMax" int4 NOT NULL,
  "preparationTimeMin" int4 NOT NULL,
  "price" numeric NOT NULL,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."menuItemCustomizationGroup" (
  "groupId" text NOT NULL,
  "isRequired" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "maximumSelections" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "menuItemId" text NOT NULL,
  "minimumSelections" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("menuItemId", "groupId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."menuItemIngredient" (
  "displayOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "ingredientId" text NOT NULL,
  "menuItemId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("menuItemId", "ingredientId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."message" (
  "body" text NOT NULL,
  "conversationId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "readAt" timestamptz(3),
  "senderId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."order" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "customerId" text,
  "etaMinutes" int4,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "orderNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "placedAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PLACED' NOT NULL,
  "subtotal" numeric NOT NULL,
  "tableId" text,
  "taxAmount" numeric NOT NULL,
  "taxRate" numeric NOT NULL,
  "total" numeric NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "order_status_check_ddbf93e6" CHECK ("status" IN ('PLACED', 'IN_KITCHEN', 'READY', 'SERVED', 'PAID', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."orderItem" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "itemNameSnapshot" text NOT NULL,
  "menuItemId" text,
  "orderId" text NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "subtotal" numeric NOT NULL,
  "unitPrice" numeric NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."orderItemCustomization" (
  "optionId" text NOT NULL,
  "optionNameSnapshot" text NOT NULL,
  "orderItemId" text NOT NULL,
  "priceDeltaSnapshot" numeric NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("orderItemId", "optionId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."payment" (
  "amount" numeric NOT NULL,
  "billId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "method" text NOT NULL,
  "paidAt" timestamptz(3),
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "transactionReference" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "payment_method_check_ff4aee9d" CHECK ("method" IN ('CASH', 'CARD', 'ONLINE', 'OTHER')),
  CONSTRAINT "payment_status_check_eb2dfa4f" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'REFUNDED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."reservation" (
  "cancelledAt" timestamptz(3),
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "customerId" text NOT NULL,
  "endTime" time(0) NOT NULL,
  "guestCount" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "reservationDate" date NOT NULL,
  "startTime" time(0) NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "tableId" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "reservation_status_check_ea1a6738" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED', 'CANCELLED', 'COMPLETED', 'NO_SHOW'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."restaurantTable" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "seatingCapacity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'AVAILABLE' NOT NULL,
  "tableNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "zoneId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "restaurantTable_status_check_ab3a9241" CHECK ("status" IN ('AVAILABLE', 'MAINTENANCE', 'INACTIVE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."role" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "role_name_check_18d69a07" CHECK ("name" IN ('ADMIN', 'WAITER', 'CHEF', 'CUSTOMER'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."tableZone" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user" (
  "accountStatus" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "approvalStatus" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "fullName" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "passwordHash" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "user_accountStatus_check_a46630b9" CHECK ("accountStatus" IN ('ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED', 'DISABLED')),
  CONSTRAINT "user_approvalStatus_check_40e639db" CHECK ("approvalStatus" IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."userRole" (
  "assignedAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "roleId" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("userId", "roleId")
)
